sentence: This project upgrades an outdated preclinical MRI scanner so it can run rapid, high resolution scans for cancer, neurodegenerative disease and cardiac studies.
This project builds a tool that uses computer vision to identify mosquito larvae species from images.
This project tests whether a shared decision-making system helps breast cancer patients choose treatments that match their goals, values and preferences.
This project studies how fibroblast subpopulations help mammalian digit tips regenerate after amputation.
This project tests an oral immunotherapy drug in dogs with osteosarcoma to see if it can prevent metastasis to the lung.
This project trains deep learning models to read digital kidney biopsy images and assess vascular pathology and cardiovascular prognosis.
This project tests how well contrast-enhanced ultrasound can find residual hepatocellular carcinoma and other solid tumors after chemoembolization.
This project tests an intervention tailored to youths to improve HIV prevention and HIV care for vulnerable youths across African countries.
This project uses a wearable device to measure time older siblings spend in close proximity with parents before and after a younger sibling is born.
This project studies how Pseudomonas aeruginosa uses a toxin to block pyroptosis, a cell death that helps corneal epithelial cells defend against bacteria.
This project studies how clotting factor VIII misfolds and harms hepatocytes in mice, and tests variants that fold better for hemophilia A gene therapy.
This project builds a 3D hydrogel system that copies how mesenchymal stem cells and chondrosarcoma cells communicate in the tumor microenvironment.
This project studies how papillomaviruses evade the immune system and looks for ways to activate it to clear persistent infections.
This project tries to find out how one form of apolipoprotein E affects whether brain lipoproteins protect against Alzheimer's disease.
This project provides shared imaging and electrophysiology instruments for studying the normal structure and function of the visual system and its pathological alterations.
This project builds an imaging system that tests whether single bacterial or fungal cells resist antimicrobials and identifies them within 2 hours.
This project uses in silico methods to test how alveolar cleft shape and size and repair techniques affect orofacial function and graft failure.
This project studies the genetic and metabolic rules that control how macrophages become activated.
This project studies how changes in cellular organization affect growth, death and adaptation in single bacterial cells.
This project focuses on lung biology and disorders of the respiratory tract.
